comment: RedStone's primary production signers, as Ethereum addresses.
The list is the only trusted input the oracle has. A signature proves who
wrote a price; this file is what says whose word counts. So it lives in the
repository, reviewable in a diff, rather than in an environment variable
that one deploy can change without anyone seeing it.
Three of these five must agree before a price applies. Rotating one is
set_signers, which is admin only and leaves a transaction behind.
